epic_median_ed_los_suicidal_behavior.long_name: Median ED Length of Stay for Encounters with a Suicidal Behavior Diagnosis
epic_median_ed_los_suicidal_behavior.short_description: Monthly median ED length of stay, in minutes, for encounters with a suicidal behavior diagnosis.
epic_median_ed_los_suicidal_behavior.long_description: Monthly median emergency department length of stay (minutes) for ED encounters carrying Epic's "Suicidal behavior" ED Diagnoses grouping. Data from Epic Cosmos SlicerDicer session 2852625 ("Median ED Length of Stay (mins) and Percentage of Sliced Population by ED Diagnoses and State of Residence and Age at Time of Visit Range"): data model ED Encounters, population base All ED Encounters, criteria Country of Residence = United States of America, date range 7/1/2022-6/30/2026. Stratified by state of residence, month, and Epic's own "Age at Time of Visit" buckets (not the PopHIVE standard age bands). A median computed from a small underlying encounter count cannot be recovered from a denominator the way a suppressed count can, so a suppressed cell is left missing rather than imputed; see epic_median_ed_los_suicidal_behavior_suppressed_flag.
epic_median_ed_los_suicidal_behavior.statement: In {location}, the median ED length of stay for encounters with a suicidal behavior diagnosis was {value} minutes.

epic_median_ed_los_suicidal_behavior_sup.short_name: Suppressed flag: median ED LOS, suicidal behavior
epic_median_ed_los_suicidal_behavior_sup.long_name: Suppression flag for the suicidal-behavior median ED length of stay
epic_median_ed_los_suicidal_behavior_sup.short_description: Indicates the median ED length of stay cell was suppressed by Epic and left missing (no denominator available to impute from).
epic_median_ed_los_suicidal_behavior_sup.long_description: 1 when Epic Cosmos left the cell blank (a small-cell suppression, since the underlying encounter count was too small to report a median); 0 otherwise. Unlike a simple count, a median duration statistic cannot be reconstructed from a denominator, so epic_median_ed_los_suicidal_behavior is left NA wherever this flag is 1, rather than imputed. The flag is computed before this decision, so it records what Epic withheld.

epic_pct_sliced_population_suicidal_beha.long_name: Share of Suicidal-Behavior ED Encounters in this State/Age/Month Cell
epic_pct_sliced_population_suicidal_beha.short_description: This cell's share of that month's total US suicidal-behavior ED encounters, NOT a prevalence rate.
epic_pct_sliced_population_suicidal_beha.long_description: Epic Cosmos's own "Percentage of Sliced Population" measure, from SlicerDicer session 2852625. IMPORTANT: this is a compositional share, not a prevalence rate. Verified empirically against the exported grid: summed across every age bucket at the national level it equals ~100% for a given month, and summed across every state at age "Overall" it also equals ~100% - consistent with (this cell's suicidal-behavior encounter count) / (total US suicidal-behavior encounters that month, across all states and ages) x 100. It is NOT the share of all ED encounters (any diagnosis) that carry a suicidal behavior diagnosis - that would require a denominator (a total ED encounter count) that this export does not contain. A populous state will show a large share here purely from encounter volume, independent of its actual rate of this diagnosis; do not compare this measure across geographies as if it were a rate. Bounded values reported by Epic as "<0.01%" are imputed at half the bound (0.005) and flagged suppressed, same as a fully blank cell (see epic_pct_sliced_population_suicidal_behavior_suppressed_flag).
epic_pct_sliced_population_suicidal_beha.statement: In {location}, {value}% of that month's US suicidal-behavior ED encounters were in this age group.

epic_pct_sliced_population_suicidal_beha.short_name: Suppressed flag: % sliced population, suicidal behavior
epic_pct_sliced_population_suicidal_beha.long_name: Suppression flag for the suicidal-behavior sliced-population percentage
epic_pct_sliced_population_suicidal_beha.short_description: Indicates the percentage cell was suppressed: either left blank by Epic, or reported as a bounded value like "<0.01%".
epic_pct_sliced_population_suicidal_beha.long_description: 1 when Epic Cosmos reported the cell as blank (left NA in epic_pct_sliced_population_suicidal_behavior, since there is no denominator to impute a missing percentage from) or as a bounded value such as "<0.01%" (imputed at half the bound, e.g. 0.005); 0 when Epic reported an exact value. The flag is computed before any imputation.

epic_cosmos.name: Epic Cosmos
epic_cosmos.description: Epic Cosmos is a collaborative research platform containing de-identified patient data from over 300 million patients across more than 1,600 hospitals and health systems using Epic electronic health record systems. Data is accessed via SlicerDicer, a self-service analytics tool. The dataset includes emergency department visits, diagnoses, immunizations, laboratory results, and other clinical data. Due to privacy protections, counts fewer than 10 are suppressed and imputed. Coverage extends across all U.S. states and territories. Note that county-level and city-level stratifications could differ markedly in total sample size due to high levels of missingness of county data in some states.
epic_cosmos.restrictions: The data can be re-used with appropriate attribution. A suggested citation relating to this data is 'Results of research performed with Epic Cosmos were obtained from the PopHIVE platform (https://github.com/PopHIVE/Ingest).'
